tests.title: local alpha artwork survives private play, backup, owned publication, versioned reload and credit download
damaged saved artwork stays visible as a repair task and never silently publishes
different games retain their own raster backs through editor, private play, publication, guest inspection and backup
missing game-back images show a playable fallback and recover through retry
real saved raster draft survives desktop rule edits, storage recovery, private review and idempotent publication
artwork source field stays above its footer with keyboard focus at 390px and short height, including decode failure
a public raster game exposes its identity and host action before artwork, preserving original downloads and invite entry
long titles and absent, landscape or failed covers keep the entry usable across narrow, short and desktop layouts
detail hosting keeps Close and Create table usable at short height and preserves the game through sign-in dismissal
fixture model goes through real repair into an unpublished playable draft, then explicit publication and multiplayer
provider failure preserves the prompt and never opens an accepted draft
browser storage failure preserves accepted output and retries without another model request
fixture review warnings, authored identity and saved-file recovery survive private play
hosting keeps keyboard focus in the dialog and restores it after Escape
hosting hands focus to the invite and keeps the current app origin
the host dialog does not intercept Escape from the separate sign-in overlay
menu actions still accept a fresh mouse click and keyboard activation
releasing a hand long press keeps the card private until a fresh menu tap
game-directed cover and back finish without resetting play, then survive publication, privacy and editable backup
blank replacements retain selected originals and retry only artwork; interrupted replies reuse stored results
browser quota failure keeps prepared artwork downloadable and saves it without another provider operation
unconfigured illustration preserves the playable rules and separate briefs without sample artwork
source transport with a fixture provider preserves private input through play, editing and editable backup
a real mastered creator bundle survives editor import, backup, private dice events, publication, credit download and guest reload
normal card draws in another seat stay silent while public and own card events remain audible
source fetch and decoder failures show retry, preserve playable fallback and recover to exact decoded assets
two people play Dice Dash to a winner, hear feedback, and retain the finished game after reload
named cards remain private in hands, play visibly to the table, reveal and survive reload
mobile table keeps play controls reachable without horizontal overflow
an invalid invite provides a recovery route
rules support keyboard reading and copied invites use the current origin with honest feedback
a real transport interruption restores play and updates host controls on both clients
a failed table view offers recovery and reload preserves the existing private hand

scope: 940 unit tests passed;24 browser cases passed and9 failed. Four login429s confirmed in normal Worker logs. Not a release pass.
